tools_helpful.evidence: Scaffolded the WinUI 3 project, rewrote namespaces, injected TODO[migrate-001] pointing at PATTERNS.md#getforcurrentview for DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView(); the agent resolved that TODO correctly with a Win32 EnumDisplaySettings + AppWindow.Changed approach.
Gave the agent the GetForCurrentView replacement table so it did not blindly keep DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView().

tools_problematic.problem: Reported PASS ('app stayed alive 10s', pid 29580/22120) even though the single scenario page fails to render. The blank-page failure is invisible to a process-alive gate because the NRE was swallowed by the nested scenario Frame's NavigationFailed handler.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt lines 1926-1930 and 1957-1958 show PASS; score notes show 0/5 controls, blank page.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only detects DisplayInformation via the generic \bGetForCurrentView\s*\( pattern. Static/instance members that do NOT go through GetForCurrentView() — DisplayInformation.AutoRotationPreferences (get/set), CurrentOrientation, NativeOrientation, OrientationChanged — are undetected, so no TODO is injected and the agent leaves them in place.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add an adaptable entry matching \bDisplayInformation\b routed to the getforcurrentview anchor.

failed_apis.why_tried: Scenario1_Orientation.OnNavigatedTo reads App.MainWindow!.AppWindow to subscribe to AppWindow.Changed.
failed_apis.root_cause: The scaffold's MainWindow constructor calls RootFrame.Navigate(typeof(MainPage)); MainPage.OnNavigatedTo adds a NavigationViewItem and sets SelectedItem, which cascades synchronously into ScenarioFrame.Navigate(Scenario1). All of this runs INSIDE `new MainWindow()`, before App.OnLaunched assigns `MainWindow = window`. So App.MainWindow is null and `App.MainWindow!.AppWindow` throws NullReferenceException.
failed_apis.fix: Keep the MainWindow constructor inert: assign App.MainWindow before Activate and defer the first RootFrame.Navigate to an Activated/Loaded handler (documented at PATTERNS.md 'Initialization order — keep MainWindow's constructor inert').

failed_apis.why_tried: Scenario1 reads it in UpdateContent() and sets it in ApplyRotationLock_Click to report/lock auto-rotation.
failed_apis.root_cause: DisplayInformation is CoreWindow/ApplicationView-bound; its members compile but throw at runtime in a WinUI 3 desktop app. This is a latent second failure (masked in this trial by the earlier NRE) that would still leave the page broken once the init-order bug is fixed.
failed_apis.fix: Auto-rotation lock has no WinUI 3 desktop equivalent; report current/native orientation via Win32 EnumDisplaySettings (which the agent already did) and drop/guard the AutoRotationPreferences get/set.

doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, 'Initialization order — keep MainWindow's constructor inert' (line ~291)
doc_errors.wrong: "Validator catches this race with a 10s smoke launch after the build healthcheck passes."
doc_errors.correct: The smoke launch only catches it when the null-static read reaches the ROOT frame and crashes the process. When the offending page is reached through a nested content Frame (e.g. a NavigationView scenario frame), Frame.Navigate marshals the exception into NavigationFailed WITHOUT crashing — the process stays alive and the smoke launch reports green while the page is blank.

special_apis.special_handling: Static members (AutoRotationPreferences) and instance members via GetForCurrentView() are all view-bound. Orientation READ -> Win32 EnumDisplaySettings/DEVMODE.dmDisplayOrientation; auto-rotation LOCK -> no desktop equivalent.

errors_encountered.error: Navigation to DisplayOrientation.Scenario1_Orientation failed: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
errors_encountered.root_cause: NullReferenceException from App.MainWindow!.AppWindow read in Scenario1.OnNavigatedTo while App.MainWindow is still null during MainWindow construction (scaffold navigates from the ctor).
errors_encountered.fix: Defer first navigation until after App.MainWindow is assigned (constructor-inert pattern).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent declared success on a 'stayed alive 10s' smoke launch and never drove the shell to confirm the one scenario rendered.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill text overstated that the smoke launch/validator catches the null-static init-order race; agent trusted the green smoke launch.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — shipped a blank page.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correcting the false 'validator catches this race' claim and reinforcing that page rendering must be verified per scenario (already in silent-navigation-failures); and injecting a TODO for DisplayInformation so the AutoRotationPreferences trap is surfaced too.
